Herbal teas that soothe digestion, like ginger or chrysanthemum, could also help you stay comfortable afterward.
(c) Since you’ve recently taken up home pottery as a hobby, be mindful that lengthy holiday meals can sometimes lead to long periods of sitting without movement, which might make it harder to get back to your creative projects comfortably. Light stretching, gentle walks, or keeping hydrated could help you transition back to your activities. You might also enjoy calming teas to ease back into your crafting rhythm.
(d) Since many Taiwanese holiday dishes can be beautifully rich in flavor and oil, you might want to balance them with lighter, vegetable-based sides to avoid feeling sluggish afterward. Taking your time to savor each bite and enjoying a pot of warm oolong tea could help your digestion. This way, you honor both the celebration and your body’s comfort.
